buffs.name: United Strength
buffs.description: With 2/3 Anomaly Agents, squad Anomaly Proficiency increases by 30/70 and Attribute Anomaly DMG by 10%/25%. Inflicting an Attribute Anomaly also reduces enemy All-Attribute RES by 15% for 10s.

buffs.name: Frost Reins
buffs.description: Attack Agents gain 25% ATK. Basic, EX Special, or Chain Attack hits ignore 30% Ice and Ether RES. Hitting a Stunned enemy increases its Stun DMG Multiplier by 40% for 5s.

buffs.name: Breakthrough
buffs.description: Rupture Agents gain 15% Sheer DMG and reduce Miasma Shield 30% faster. In Ether Veil, Ether DMG increases by 25%; hits also raise the enemy's Stun DMG Multiplier by 25% for 10s.

encounters.name: Girtablullu: Stagnant Aberrant
encounters.mechanic: Apply Attribute Anomalies to add Blight Marks. Each mark lasts 30 seconds and increases Attribute Anomaly DMG taken by 8%.

encounters.name: Ye Shiyuan the Thrall
encounters.mechanic: The Thrall gains Contract and Self-Sacrifice when changing turns with Sobek. Stun the Thrall to increase CRIT DMG taken by 50%.

encounters.name: Miasma Priest
encounters.mechanic: Each phase change raises Anomaly Buildup RES by 10% and CRIT DMG taken by 30%. Break the Miasmic Shield to remove the stacks.

encounters.name: Rewritten: Sanguine Sweeper
encounters.mechanic: Trigger SHUTDOWN to reduce All-Attribute RES by 10%. Attack Agents then gain 20% ATK, 25% PEN Ratio, and 60% Ice and Ether CRIT DMG.
